sentences.text:
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions) CRL.M.C. 838/2026 & CRL.M.A. 3299/2026 (stay)
2. Petitioner seeks quashing of case FIR No. 321/2022 of Police Station Dwarka South for offence under Section 498A/406/377/34 IPC on merits.
3. Quashing of FIR and proceedings is sought mainly on the ground that there are no specific allegations of cruelty in the FIR.

In this regard, learned counsel has addressed for almost 15-20 minutes in pre-lunch as well as post- lunch session and needs another 15-20 minutes to conclude,
which is not possible due to pending heavy board.
4. Further, learned APP for State submits that the matter is already listed for framing of charge and same arguments as are being advanced today can be raised before the trial court.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 02/02/2026 at 20:49:40 5.
6. In the meanwhile, State may file status report.
Digitized record of the trial court also be requisitioned within four weeks since the petitioner has not placed on record complete chargesheet and documents.
7. It is made clear that having gone through the FIR, I do not find it a fit case to stay proceedings of the trial court.
